title: thelypteris pilosiuscula
intro: Thelypteris pilosiuscula, commonly known as the hairy maidenhair fern, is a species of flowering plant in the family Thelypteridaceae. It is a perennial fern native to Central and South America. The health benefits of Thelypteris pilosiuscula include its potential to lower blood pressure, reduce inflammation, and act as an antioxidant, although more research is needed to confirm these effects. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which may contribute to its therapeutic actions, such as anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial effects.
